text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Bank of Portugal ready to sell part of its gold reserves whose global value amounts to 810 billion escudos, Bank source tells newspaper in Washington.
- Planning minister considers a tax on those whose properties may increase in value because of public investment.
- Retailer Sonae betting on new business in the specialised distribution area.
- Private television company SIC faces unexpected difficulties.
- Opinion poll gives victory to Socialist Party (PS) in the semi-autonomous island of Azores on the 13 0ctober. It would be a suprise after twenty years of a Social Democratic Party (PSD) Government.
- Communist-led trade union CGTP and employers group CIP see possible agreement on several points in negotiations on working conditions.
- Six months after winning the Social Democratic Party (PSD) leadership, Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa threatens to quit if party congress this weekend does not approve his reform proposals.
- Natural gas will arrive in Portugal in December and will start to be distributed in the end of January 1997. The government is to extend the distribution network.
- Spain's Tabacalera and its Portuguese allies bidding for Tabaqueira in its privatisation would list the company in both Lisbon and Madrid.
